therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Proteasome inhibition, CD38-targeted immunotherapy, and corticosteroid anti-inflammatory effects
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Multiple myeloma cell death through proteasome inhibition, immune-mediated tumor cell killing via CD38 targeting, and reduction of inflammation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with relapsed and/or refractory multiple myeloma
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Progression-free survival (PFS) as assessed by Independent Review Committee

biomarker_changes: MRD negative complete response rate at 12 months: 12.8% (KdD) vs 1.9% (Kd), OR 7.819
MRD negative status at 12 months: 18.3% (KdD) vs 5.2% (Kd), OR 4.403
results.dose_information: Carfilzomib IV infusion over 30 minutes, daratumumab IV infusion, dexamethasone oral/IV with age-based dose modifications for patients >75 years

context.duration: Median treatment duration 79.29 weeks (KdD) vs 40.29 weeks (Kd), follow-up up to 58 months
